title: Disappointed
text: I have been getting the snack boxes for about a year now. When they first started they had a nice variety of healthy options that were different from usual snack fare. The last four boxes however have been a huge disappointment. I have even gotten the same product three months in a row. And the snacks seem to have degraded from actual healthy options to “health halo” options such as natural potato chips. After having been extremely disappointed for the third month in a row now, I am cancelling my subscription. I wouldn’t even recommend this unless you like getting the same things over and over.
label: negative
